findings.title: Fail closed when the artifact directory cannot be read.

findings.body:
**`reviewOk` throws on a review row with a missing or non-array `initialBlocking`.**

Line 72 calls `r.initialBlocking.every(...)` after a check only for `null`. If `initialBlocking` is `undefined` (a field omitted from the raw record) or a non-array value, `.every` is not callable. The call throws a `TypeError` inside `admit`. That aborts the whole `computeOutcomePanels` call.

The file header says malformed rows must land in `unknown` with a reason. Every other predicate in this file returns `false` for a bad shape, so this one is inconsistent. A single bad review row should become a `corrupt` entry from `admit`. It should not crash the run.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-  (r.initialBlocking === null || r.initialBlocking.every(fingerprintOk)) &&
+  (r.initialBlocking === null ||
+    (Array.isArray(r.initialBlocking) && r.initialBlocking.every(fingerprintOk))) &&
```
</details>
findings.title: `reviewOk` throws on a review row with a missing or non-array `initialBlocking`.
Reject a root that has no `path` instead of reading from the current directory.
Restore must not report an unverified entry as `present`.
